verdict.rationale: The pack shows no documented Logseq feature for controlling data retention or deletion, such as deleting synced data from servers, setting retention periods, or purging history. The closest items are adjacent controls: per-graph opt-in sync that lets a graph stay local only, export, and end-to-end encryption. These cover data location, portability and confidentiality, not retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
